answer.reason: The verses tell of several deeds of Abishai beyond the relations and the killing of Abner already in the summary.

clauses.english: went down with David by night to Saul's camp and was forbidden to strike the sleeping king
clauses.quote: So David and Abishai came to the people by night

clauses.english: saved David by striking down the Philistine Ishbibenob
clauses.quote: succoured him, and smote the Philistine, and killed him

clauses.english: lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them
clauses.quote: he lifted up his spear against three hundred, and slew them

doubts: Left out his request to take off Shimei's head (2SA 16:9), his command of part of the army against Ammon and Absalom, and the slaying of eighteen thousand Edomites (1CH 18:12), to keep to the chief deeds.
Left out the killing of Abner (2SA 3:30) because the summary already names it.
1CH 12:4 names a different man, Ismaiah, and was left out.
